Preset of Configuration for the RSPH Cluster

Source: R/slurmworkflow_helpers.R
swf_configs_rsph.Rd

Preset of Configuration for the RSPH Cluster

Usage

swf_configs_rsph(
  partition = "epimodel",
  r_version = "4.6.1",
  mail_user = NULL,
  cleanup_workers = TRUE
)

Arguments

partition

The RSPH partition, or partitions, to submit to: a single name, a character vector, or a comma-separated string such as "epimodel,CIDMATH". With several partitions, SLURM starts each job on whichever can run it first. The default, "epimodel", is the lab's dedicated partition. See the "Partitions" section for the valid names.

r_version

Which version of R to load with spack. Use the full version ("4.6.1" or "4.5.1") matching the R version in the project lockfile. A partial version such as "4.3" can match several spack builds, which makes spack load fail, so it gives a warning.

mail_user

The mail address to send the messages to, default is NULL (see 'sbatch –mail-type' argument)

cleanup_workers

If TRUE (the default), append swf_cleanup_r_workers to r_loader so each step reaps its own R workers on cancel or timeout. RSPH has no cgroup containment, so without this, workers survive scancel and squat on cores SLURM has re-allocated, starving later tasks. See swf_cleanup_r_workers.

Value

a list with four elements:

  • default_sbatch_opts: sbatch options to pass to slurmworkflow::create_workflow(). They set the partition list, mail-type = "FAIL" and, when mail_user is given, mail-user.

  • renv_sbatch_opts: sbatch options for the step_tmpl_renv_restore() step: 16 GB of memory, 4 CPUs and 180 minutes, as in the EpiModelHIV-Template. The first restore under a new R version builds every package from source and takes longer than later ones.

  • r_loader: bash lines that make R available on a compute node. Pass them to the setup_lines argument of the step_tmpl_ functions.

  • max_cores: the largest cpus-per-task a single task can request on every listed partition. It is 32, except 16 when interactive-cpu is listed and 31 when largemem is listed.

Partitions

The RSPH partitions as of October 2026. All nodes have 32 cores.

PartitionTime limitMax cores per taskNotes
epimodelnone32The lab's dedicated nodes; the default
CIDMATHnone32Dedicated nodes shared with three other groups
short-cpu8 hours32The cluster's default partition
day-long-cpu1 day32
week-long-cpu7 days32At most 6 nodes per job
month-long-cpu31 days32At most 4 nodes per job
interactive-cpu12 hours16Meant for srun sessions
largemem7 days31High-memory nodes

The preemptable partition no longer exists, and asking for it is an error.

default_sbatch_opts sets no time, so a step without its own time runs up to the limit of the partition it lands on. A step whose time exceeds a partition's limit can only start on the other partitions in the list.

RSPH gives each CPU 5 GB of memory by default (DefMemPerCPU = 5120) and does not enforce memory requests. A step that uses more than it asked for is not killed, but it can starve other jobs on the node, so request what each step needs with mem-per-cpu. Keep mem = "0" (a whole node) for network estimation.

SLURM's MaxArraySize is 1001 on RSPH, so one array holds at most 1001 tasks (indices 0 to 1000). We use max_array_size = 1000 in array steps.

Node setup

r_loader sources the shared spack environment, unloads everything, and loads R. It deliberately does not load git: git is on the default path on RSPH, and the project template has not loaded it for some time. The git_version argument was removed accordingly.

Examples

hpc_configs <- swf_configs_rsph(mail_user = "user@emory.edu")
hpc_configs$default_sbatch_opts
#> $partition
#> [1] "epimodel"
#> 
#> $`mail-type`
#> [1] "FAIL"
#> 
#> $`mail-user`
#> [1] "user@emory.edu"
#> 

# Start each step on whichever partition can run it first
swf_configs_rsph(c("epimodel", "CIDMATH", "short-cpu"))$default_sbatch_opts
#> $partition
#> [1] "epimodel,CIDMATH,short-cpu"
#> 
#> $`mail-type`
#> [1] "FAIL"
#> 

# A project whose lockfile records R 4.5
swf_configs_rsph(r_version = "4.5.1", cleanup_workers = FALSE)$r_loader
#> [1] ". /projects/epimodel/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh"
#> [2] "spack unload -a"                                    
#> [3] "spack load r@4.5.1"
